metadata.title: Night Shift Rules at Tower 13
metadata.subtitle: Rule #1: Never answer the Floor 13 intercom after 3:00 AM. Rule #4: Never ask why the building has no tenants.

nodes.text: 2:55 AM · Your first graveyard shift at Tower 13. The lobby smells faintly of wet ash. Your supervisor texts you the mandatory night rules.
Memorize this, Morgan: (1) Never answer the Floor 13 intercom. (2) Keep lobby doors chained. (3) If Camera 4 looks empty, DO NOT zoom in.
Got it, Chief. Wait—what’s Rule 4? And why is the elevator heading down from Floor 13 right now?

nodes.transcript: [static, urgent] "Step away from the elevator doors! If a woman in a red coat steps out, stare at your desk and count to 30!"

nodes.text: Rule 4: Never check the fire-inspection plaque by the stairs.

nodes.prompt: DING. The elevator doors slide open at 03:00 AM:

options.label: Stare at your desk and count to 30
options.player_reply_text: 1... 2... 3... I smell smoke right in front of my desk.

options.label: Glance at the lobby mirror instead
options.player_reply_text: I glanced at the mirror—the elevator is empty, only wet footprints!

nodes.text: Good. Don’t look up until the elevator chimes again. Did the Floor 13 intercom light turn red?
I told you not to look! Now she knows you’re awake—lock the security booth glass!
BZZZT. The Floor 13 intercom button flashes crimson. A frantic voice rattles the lobby speaker.
Do NOT press talk! Look at Camera 4 on your monitor—tell me if the hallway is still empty!
Camera 4 is completely empty... except the fire-exit door at the end is rattling violently!

nodes.headline: Someone Is Trapped on 13
nodes.teaser_text: Next: Camera 4 catches what is pounding on the locked stairwell door.

nodes.text: 3:04 AM · The smoke alarm chirps once, then dies. Your desk monitor freezes on Camera 4.
Send me a screenshot of Camera 4, Morgan. Whatever you do, don’t leave the booth.
Sending it now—why does the timestamp on the CCTV say 2020 instead of tonight?!

nodes.transcript: [police radio static] "Attention any unit near Tower 13: a false 911 ping came from the condemned lobby booth. Verify no trespassers inside."

nodes.text: Ignore the radio. That’s just interference from the street.

nodes.caption: Camera 4 at 03:05 — empty 13th-floor hallway while frantic knocking echoes through the intercom.

nodes.prompt: The police radio crackles again on your belt:

options.label: Ask Chief Miller why police called it condemned
options.player_reply_text: Chief, why did police dispatch say Tower 13 is condemned?!

options.label: Reply directly to Police Dispatch
options.player_reply_text: Dispatch, I’m the night guard on duty inside Tower 13 lobby!

nodes.text: They’re looking at the old city registry! Now stop talking and check the lobby doors—someone is outside!
Put that radio down! If you talk to them, the shift loop breaks before 4:00 AM!
A cold palm slams against the security booth glass. On the glass, a soot-black handprint slowly slides downward.
Sir, Tower 13 burned down 6 years ago on November 25th! Twelve people died because the stairwell was chained shut!
Chained shut...? Wait—the heavy iron padlock key is clipped to MY belt right now...

nodes.headline: The Padlock Key on Your Belt
nodes.teaser_text: Next: You finally read Rule 4 on the charred fire plaque.

nodes.text: 3:15 AM · The fluorescent lobby lights flicker out. Red emergency exit signs bathe the walls in blood-red glow.
Don’t listen to dispatch, Morgan! Stay in the booth until 4:00 AM and you’ll get your paycheck!
Why do my fingers smell like smoke, Chief? And why is my badge dated 6 years ago?!

nodes.transcript: [voice cracking with static] "Because you fell asleep on shift, Morgan! You chained the fire doors to stop trespassers—and forgot to unlock them when Floor 13 caught fire!"

nodes.text: You’ve been working this exact shift every night since the fire.

nodes.prompt: Thick grey smoke begins curling under the elevator doors:

options.label: Grab the padlock key and run for Floor 13
options.player_reply_text: I’m unlocking the stairwell right now—even if it’s 6 years too late!

options.label: Call Dispatch to verify my name on the report
options.player_reply_text: Dispatch, check the 2020 Tower 13 fire report—is my name on it?!

nodes.text: Dispatch chimes in: "Patrol car is pulling up to the fenced lot—stay away from the rusted stairwell!"
Sir... your name is listed as the night guard who died trying to unlock Floor 13 from the lobby...
Twelve silhouettes appear behind the frosted lobby glass—none of them moving, all of them facing your booth.
Look at the lobby security monitor, Morgan. They’re not trying to hurt you—they’re waiting for you to finally unlock the chain.
I can see them on Camera 1... twelve shadows standing right outside the glass...

nodes.headline: Twelve Shadows at the Glass
nodes.teaser_text: Next: Camera 1 captures the silhouettes surrounding the booth.

nodes.text: 3:28 AM · The security monitor flashes white. Twelve dark silhouettes stand motionless on the lobby feed.
Patrol officers are outside the perimeter fence! They see a flashlight beam moving inside the burned lobby—is that you?!
Yes! Tell them the chain on the stairwell is still locked—I’m unlocking it now!

nodes.transcript: [gentle, echoing] "Take the brass key out of your pocket, Morgan. Step out of the booth. Break Rule 2."

nodes.text: I’m one of the twelve, Morgan. I forgive you.

nodes.caption: Lobby security cam at 03:29 — dark silhouettes frozen in front of the chained stairwell doors.

nodes.prompt: Your hand grips the cold iron padlock on the stairwell door:

options.label: Turn the key and drop the iron chain
options.player_reply_text: The chain is off! The door is open—you can all leave now!

options.label: Apologize over the Floor 13 intercom first
options.player_reply_text: I’m so sorry I locked the stairs. I’m opening it right now!

nodes.text: Dispatch reports: "Whoa—the rusted chain inside the lobby just fell to the floor by itself! Nobody is holding it!"
Dispatch reports: "Our officers heard an old intercom click off—and the stairwell door just swung wide open!"
CLANK. The heavy chain hits the concrete. A warm breeze rushes down from Floor 13, sweeping every trace of smoke out of the lobby.
Look at the lobby clock, Morgan. It finally passed 3:59 AM. Your shift is over.
The silhouettes are gone... and the morning sun is finally touching the glass.

nodes.headline: Shift Complete at 4:00 AM
nodes.teaser_text: Finale next: What the police find on the security desk at dawn.

nodes.text: 4:00 AM · Two patrol officers step through the unlocked front doors of the ruined Tower 13.
Unit 911 log: "Lobby clear. One antique brass padlock key resting neatly on the charred guard desk."
Leave the stairwell door propped open for them.

nodes.transcript: [calm police radio] "Copy that. Wait—the cracked logbook on the desk has a fresh entry written in ash: SHIFT COMPLETE — 04:00."

nodes.text: Thank you for unlocking the door, Morgan.

nodes.prompt: One last chime echoes from the Floor 13 elevator:

options.label: Set down your guard badge
options.player_reply_text: Signing off my final night shift.

options.label: Turn off Camera 4 for good
options.player_reply_text: Camera 4 offline. No more 3AM rules.

nodes.text: The officers salute the empty guard desk as the first dawn light breaks over Tower 13.
The monitor goes permanently dark—and the 911 phantom pings from Tower 13 never happen again.
For the first time in 6 years, the stairwell door stands open to the morning air.
System archive closed: Tower 13 night-shift anomaly resolved at 04:05.
Twelve footsteps fade into the daylight. I can finally go home.

nodes.headline: 04:06 AM · The Thirteenth Name
nodes.teaser_text: Act 2 begins: Twelve silhouettes left—but the 2020 manifest listed THIRTEEN people, and the elevator just dropped to B2.

nodes.text: 04:06 AM · One minute after the lobby clock cleared, the ruined elevator groans to life—its red display dropping past Ground straight to B2.
Wait—our patrol officers haven’t left Tower 13! The brass key on the desk just slid off by itself, and the elevator dropped to Sub-Basement B2!
Why didn’t the loop end?! Twelve silhouettes walked out of the stairwell—what else is still down there?!

nodes.transcript: [crackling through stairwell echo] "Morgan, listen! Twelve victims left—because the 2020 manifest listed THIRTEEN people! And the thirteenth person walked out alive that night!"

nodes.text: Rule #5: Never let the building owner reach the Sub-Basement B2 fire vault before demolition.

nodes.prompt: Black diesel headlights cut through the perimeter fence of Tower 13:

options.label: Warn Dispatch that unmarked vans arrived
options.player_reply_text: Dispatch! Two black vans just cut the chain on the back service gate!

options.label: Ask Chief Miller who the 13th person is
options.player_reply_text: Chief, who walked out of the fire—and why did they frame me?!

nodes.text: Our two officers just spotted three men in demolition vests slipping down the service ramp toward Sub-Basement B2!
Victor Kade—the billionaire developer who owned Tower 13! YOU didn’t chain that stairwell, Morgan—he chained it from outside to collect an $18 million arson payout!
On the scorched lobby desk, a blackened magnetic keycard sits beside a freshly scratched line: "RULE #5: GUARD B2."
Demolition of Tower 13 is set for 06:00 AM! If Kade burns the B2 vault before dawn, every shred of arson proof vanishes forever!

nodes.headline: Rule #5: Guard B2
nodes.teaser_text: Next: The scorched B2 keycard unlocks the hidden sub-level where Kade buried the truth.

nodes.text: 04:15 AM · Patrol officers photograph the scorched magnetic card left on the guard desk as heavy footsteps echo below the lobby floor.
Our officers picked up the keycard from your desk—it’s stamped "TOWER 13 · B2 ARCHIVE VAULT." Why would a condemned tower have a fireproof archive?
Because the building’s black-box CCTV server and fire-inspection logs are wired straight to Sub-Basement B2!

nodes.transcript: [low metallic hum] "Before the fire, I hid the backup DVR tape inside Vault Locker 13. Tell the officers not to take the elevator—Kade rigged the shaft cables."

nodes.text: Tell the cleaners to pour thermite on Locker 13 and seal the B2 stairs.

nodes.caption: Scorched B2 master keycard found on the lobby desk — grants override access to the subterranean fire-audit vault.

nodes.prompt: The officers stand between the rusted stairwell and the humming service lift:

options.label: Order them down the concrete stairwell
options.player_reply_text: Stay out of the elevator! Take the east concrete stairwell to B2!

options.label: Trigger the lobby emergency sprinkler valve
options.player_reply_text: Tell them to crank the red B2 sprinkler wheel in the lobby closet first!

nodes.text: Good call! Two seconds after they stepped past the elevator, the lift cables snapped and crashed straight into the pit!
B2 emergency sprinklers are flooding the archive floor—nobody is lighting thermite down there now!
A thunderous boom shakes the concrete beneath Tower 13 as the lobby intercom crackles with a cold, cultured voice.
Still playing night guard after six years, Morgan? Keep your patrol cops out of my basement—this tower comes down at 6 AM.

nodes.headline: The Owner Arrives
nodes.teaser_text: Next: Victor Kade locks the B2 blast doors—and Rule #6 appears on the security monitor.

nodes.text: 04:27 AM · Knee-deep rainwater and sprinkler runoff pool across Sub-Basement B2 as sparks dance along exposed conduits.
Our officers reached the B2 landing, but the heavy steel blast door is magnetically sealed from inside! How do we bypass it?
There’s a manual fire-axe bypass box six feet left of the blast door—only night guards know the four-digit pin!

nodes.transcript: [urgent static] "Rule #6, Morgan: DO NOT open the blast door while the basement transformer is live! Kade dropped a high-voltage cable into the puddle outside!"

nodes.text: One step into that puddle and the cops fry before backup arrives.

nodes.prompt: Blue electrical arcs ripple across the dark ankle-deep water outside B2:

options.label: Yell at Dispatch to halt before stepping
options.player_reply_text: STOP! Live power cable in the water—kill the street main breaker first!

options.label: Route officers through the dry laundry chute
options.player_reply_text: Skip the flooded door—crawl through the dry air-duct above the stairwell!

nodes.text: Officer froze two inches from the puddle! Utility crew just cut the street main—water is dead and safe!
Officers dropped through the dry air-duct right behind Kade’s lookout—one hired cleaner is already in cuffs!
Inside the dark B2 corridor, the captured cleaner’s flashlight rolls across the floor—illuminating a steel door painted with a white "13."
That’s Vault 13! Inside is the forged fire-inspection certificate Kade signed two days before he killed us.

nodes.headline: The Live Puddle Trap
nodes.teaser_text: Next: Kade’s demolition timers start counting down—and the tower’s old PA system wakes up.

nodes.text: 04:38 AM · Every support pillar in Sub-Basement B2 blinks with a tiny green LED—demolition charges wired an hour early.
Emergency! The demolition contractor says nobody authorized live charges before 06:00 AM—Kade’s crew wired those pillars illegally!
He’s going to collapse Tower 13 on top of the officers AND bury Vault 13 under forty tons of rubble!

nodes.transcript: [cold chuckle over intercom] "Sixty minutes until structural implosion, guard. Tell your friends to drop Vault 13 and run—nobody mourns a condemned building."

nodes.text: The vault keypad code is the date of the fire: 1125.

nodes.prompt: Bomb squad is 15 minutes out, and Vault 13’s steel door is right in front of the officers:

options.label: Give Dispatch the 1125 vault code now
options.player_reply_text: Swipe the B2 keycard and punch 1125—grab the archive box before Kade runs!

options.label: Order bomb squad to jam wireless triggers
options.player_reply_text: Deploy a radio jammer around Tower 13—don’t let Kade trigger those charges early!

nodes.text: Vault 13 is OPEN! Officers just pulled out a fireproof steel briefcase labeled "NOV 2020 · KADE HOLDINGS"!
Mobile jammer van just rolled up to the fence! All wireless detonation frequencies around Tower 13 are completely blocked!
Inside the steel briefcase lies a crisp, untouched folder—sealed inside fireproof plastic since November 23, 2020.
Sending you a scan of the top document right now—Morgan, your signature on the 2020 fire-safety report was FORGED!

nodes.headline: The Forged Signature
nodes.teaser_text: Next: The legal document inside Vault 13 exposes an $18 million arson conspiracy.

nodes.text: 04:48 AM · Under flashlight beams inside Vault 13, officers photograph the forged inspection papers and tripled insurance policy.
Look at this rider, Morgan: Kade tripled Tower 13’s fire coverage on November 23—and forged your guard log saying the stairwell chains were "routine maintenance."
All six years I blamed myself for falling asleep... I didn’t lock those twelve people in! Kade drugged my lobby coffee and chained the doors himself!

nodes.transcript: [warm, resolute] "You died trying to break his padlock with a fire axe, Morgan. Now the whole city is about to learn the truth."

nodes.text: If the jammer blocks my remote, I’ll light the manual fuse on Pillar 1 myself.

nodes.caption: Vault 13 fire-insurance rider — $18M policy executed 48 hours before the Tower 13 blaze with forged guard sign-off.

nodes.prompt: Kade just slipped back inside the basement with a manual flare:

options.label: Warn officers to guard Pillar 1 immediately
options.player_reply_text: He’s bypassing the jammer—he’s heading for the manual fuse at Pillar 1!

options.label: Upload the forged policy to prosecutors live
options.player_reply_text: Cloud-sync that policy scan right now so even a blast can’t erase it!

nodes.text: Officers pivoted toward Pillar 1—they see Kade’s red flare glowing through the basement mist!
Uploaded and notarized on the precinct server! Even if Tower 13 collapses, Kade is finished!
Across Sub-Basement B2, the old fluorescent tube above Pillar 1 flickers—revealing a tall figure in a charred uniform blocking Kade’s path.
What the—Miller?! You died on Floor 13 six years ago! Stay back!!

nodes.headline: Chief Miller’s Stand
nodes.teaser_text: Next: Kade panics and flees deeper into the flooded generator tunnel—right into Rule #7.

nodes.text: 05:00 AM · Kade drops his flare into the water and bolts toward the sub-basement drainage tunnel while officers secure Vault 13’s second folder.
Kade dropped his briefcase in the chase! Inside is an encrypted bank receipt paying an arson contractor $450,000 the morning after the fire!
Where did he run?! That drainage tunnel doesn’t lead to the street—it loops straight back into the locked boiler pit!

nodes.transcript: [radio static, heavy boots] "Bomb squad just arrived and is disarming Pillar 1! Two officers are tracking Kade’s wet footprints into the boiler pit!"

nodes.text: There’s a second manual detonator wired inside the boiler control box.

nodes.prompt: You catch Kade’s unsent message—he’s heading for a backup detonator in the boiler room:

options.label: Alert bomb squad to cut the boiler conduit
options.player_reply_text: Tell bomb squad to sever the yellow conduit running to the boiler box!

options.label: Lock the boiler room magnetic seal remotely
options.player_reply_text: Hit the blue boiler-lock switch on the guard desk—trap him inside!

nodes.text: Bomb tech just snipped the yellow conduit—all twelve demolition charges in B2 just went permanently dead!
CLANG! The steel boiler door just slammed shut behind Kade—he’s pounding on the glass with nowhere to run!
Inside the rusted boiler room, the red intercom light blinks on—dialing your guard console directly.
Open this boiler door, Morgan! Name your price—a million, five million—just get me out of here before the smoke comes back!

nodes.headline: Trapped in the Boiler Pit
nodes.teaser_text: Next: Kade calls on the dead intercom—and faces the voice of the man he framed.

nodes.text: 05:10 AM · Smoke that isn’t real—yet smells unmistakably of November 25, 2020—begins curling beneath the boiler room door.
Our officers are outside the boiler room recording everything on bodycam! Keep Kade talking—we want his full confession on tape!
Why did you chain the stairwell on Floor 13, Kade?! Even if you wanted the insurance money, why trap twelve innocent tenants inside?!

nodes.transcript: [coughing, panicking] "Because Chief Miller found my fake structural audit! If the building didn’t burn with the Floor 13 files inside, I was going to prison for twenty years!"

nodes.text: Every word just recorded crystal clear on four police bodycams.

nodes.prompt: Kade slams his fists against the boiler room glass screaming for mercy:

options.label: Make him name the arson contractor too
options.player_reply_text: Who did you wire $450,000 to on November 26?! Say his name!

options.label: Ask why he framed you on the fire plaque
options.player_reply_text: And you forged my night log so the city blamed ME for six years?!

nodes.text: Ray Mercer—my demolition foreman! He poured the accelerant on Floor 13! I’ll testify against him, just unlock this door!
Yes! I switched your guard log after the fire! You tried to unlock the chain—you never fell asleep! Just get me out of here!
A sharp hiss silences the phantom smoke as the boiler intercom rings one last time.
We’ve got his full confession AND the foreman’s name! Look at the wire transfer receipt we just decoded from his briefcase.

nodes.headline: Confession on Tape
nodes.teaser_text: Next: The decoded bank transfer nails both Kade and his demolition foreman—who is still outside with a backup rig.

nodes.text: 05:19 AM · Dispatch sends the decrypted November 26 wire confirmation while officers cuff Kade outside the boiler pit.
Confirmed: $450,000 cleared to Ray Mercer’s shell account at 08:12 AM on November 26, 2020. Wait—Mercer is the foreman sitting in the demolition truck outside the gate RIGHT NOW!
Stop him before he realizes Kade was arrested! If he drives that demolition rig through the lobby, he’ll knock out the main support beam!

nodes.transcript: [tires screeching on radio] "All units, perimeter breach! The demolition foreman just saw Kade in cuffs—he’s reversing the heavy rig toward the south entrance!"

nodes.text: Get the officers out of Sub-Basement B2—the south beam is already cracked from 2020.

nodes.caption: Decrypted Nov 26, 2020 wire confirmation — $450,000 paid from Kade Holdings to demolition foreman Ray Mercer.

nodes.prompt: The heavy demolition truck revs its diesel engine thirty yards from the glass lobby:

options.label: Tell Dispatch to deploy road spikes at gate
options.player_reply_text: Drop the patrol spike strips across the south apron right now!

options.label: Drop the steel fire-curtain in the lobby
options.player_reply_text: Hit the manual steel fire-shutter in the lobby booth—shield the south beam!

nodes.text: Spike strips shredded all four rear tires! The rig jackknifed ten feet short of the south pillar—officers are pulling Mercer out of the cab!
The steel fire-shutter slammed down just in time—Mercer’s bumper crumpled against solid iron while patrol units boxed him in!
Metal groans and then falls still. Yet down in Sub-Basement B2, a strange cold draft pulls toward the flooded archive corridor.
Both killers are in cuffs... so why is the clock on Camera 4 STILL frozen at 03:59 AM, Morgan?

nodes.headline: Still Frozen at 03:59
nodes.teaser_text: Act 3 begins: One last presence remains inside Sub-Basement B2—and Rule #7 demands you face it.

nodes.text: 05:30 AM · Both Kade and Mercer are loaded into patrol cruisers outside, yet the lobby monitor flickers back onto Sub-Basement B2.
Twelve tenants walked into the dawn, Morgan. Every fire log is cleared. Do you know why Tower 13 won’t let go yet?
Wait... if twelve tenants were trapped on Floor 13, and Chief Miller was one of them... then who is the thirteenth name still left behind?

nodes.transcript: [gentle, echoing softly] "Look at the charred brass plaque by the stairwell, Morgan. Twelve tenants died on Floor 13—and one night guard died in the lobby."

nodes.text: The coroner never recovered the night guard’s badge from the B2 rubble chute.

nodes.prompt: Camera 4 zooms slowly toward a tarnished guard badge half-buried in B2’s flooded corridor:

options.label: Ask Dispatch to retrieve the badge from B2
options.player_reply_text: There’s one last item down in B2—my brass guard badge by the stairwell drain.

options.label: Check the back of the badge on Camera 4
options.player_reply_text: Zoom in on the back of that badge—it has my daughter’s photo taped inside.

nodes.text: Copy that, sir. One officer is stepping back down to the B2 drain right now to bring your badge out before demolition.
The officer found it—the laminated photo on the back is completely untouched by the fire. He’s holding it carefully.
Suddenly, the flooded B2 ceiling groans—a cracked concrete girder from the truck impact begins to buckle overhead.
Officer down in B2! A ceiling slab just blocked the east stairwell—he’s trapped down there with the water rising!

nodes.headline: Trapped Below the Collapse
nodes.teaser_text: Next: Chief Miller calls with Rule #7—your final chance to save the trapped officer before Tower 13 gives way.

episodes.title: Rule #7: Never Leave a Man Behind

nodes.text: 05:38 AM · Dust chokes Sub-Basement B2. The young patrol officer holding your badge is pinned behind fallen masonry as the cracked pipes gush.
Rescue crews need twenty minutes to cut through that concrete slab—and the officer says B2’s water is already chest-high!
Tell him not to panic! There is a forgotten utility hatch inside Vault 13 that climbs straight up to the street sidewalk grate!

nodes.transcript: [steady, echoing across B2] "He can’t see the hatch through the pitch-black dust, Morgan! You have to guide him step by step through the flooded corridor!"

nodes.text: This is the shift you were waiting six years to finish.

nodes.prompt: The trapped officer’s flashlight is flickering at 5% in the dark flooded hall:

options.label: Blink the B2 exit signs to light his way
options.player_reply_text: Watch the green exit arrows on the ceiling—follow every light I flash!

options.label: Guide him by counting paces from Pillar 3
options.player_reply_text: Touch Pillar 3, turn left twelve paces—Vault 13’s open door is right there!

nodes.text: Incredible—the dead emergency exit arrows just lit up one by one in sequence! He’s wading straight toward Vault 13!
Twelve paces left—his hand just hit the open steel frame of Vault 13! He’s climbing onto the dry archive shelf!
A low rumble shakes the foundation as Chief Miller’s voice rings through the guard console.
The sidewalk grate above Vault 13 is rusted shut from the outside—tell Dispatch to hook a tow chain to the grate NOW!

nodes.headline: The Rusted Sidewalk Grate
nodes.teaser_text: Next: Racing against a second ceiling collapse to pull the officer into the dawn air.

nodes.text: 05:46 AM · Street rescue crews spot the sidewalk grate above Vault 13 and latch a heavy winch cable onto the iron bars.
Winch is hooked! Wait—the officer inside Vault 13 says the ladder rungs are sheared off ten feet down. He can’t reach the hatch!
Drop a rescue harness down the shaft the second that grate pops—and tell him to climb onto the steel archive cabinet!

nodes.transcript: [hydraulic winch straining] "Grate is moving—CRACK! It’s open! Dropping the illuminated rescue rope down to him right now!"

nodes.text: Hold the steel door frame steady until he clears the shaft, Morgan.

nodes.prompt: A second concrete beam cracks above Vault 13 as the officer clips into the harness:

options.label: Tell rescue team to pull at full winch speed
options.player_reply_text: HAUL HIM UP NOW! The north ceiling beam is giving way!

options.label: Shout for him to tuck the badge inside vest
options.player_reply_text: Clip tight and hold on—don’t look back at the dark!

nodes.text: Winch at max speed—he cleared the sidewalk lip two seconds before the basement vault collapsed behind him!
He’s out on the pavement coughing, alive, and clutching your brass guard badge against his chest!
WHOOSH. A warm gust of clean morning wind sweeps out of the stairwell—carrying away the last scent of wet ash.
Wait... before the vault camera went offline, it saved one last frame from the dark corridor.

nodes.headline: Pulled Into the Dawn
nodes.teaser_text: Next: The final B2 camera frame shows who held the crumbling beam until the officer escaped.

nodes.text: 05:54 AM · On the command van screen, Dispatch plays back the final two seconds recorded before Sub-Basement B2 went dark.
Our officers are speechless, Morgan. Look at the shadow standing beside the exit door in that last corridor capture.
Nobody died on my shift tonight. Not one.

nodes.transcript: [quiet, deeply respectful] "The officer you saved just read the name on the brass badge—and he’s asking the chief to recommend a posthumous city medal of valor for you."

nodes.text: The lobby clock just ticked from 03:59 to 05:56 AM.

nodes.caption: Final archived frame from Sub-Basement B2 — lone guard silhouette standing watch until the rescue harness cleared the shaft.

nodes.prompt: The morning sky turns bright amber over Tower 13 as the sirens quiet down:

options.label: Ask Dispatch to return the badge to family
options.player_reply_text: Give my brass badge—and the photo inside—back to my daughter.

options.label: Request a memorial plaque for all 13 names
options.player_reply_text: Make sure the new plaque lists all twelve tenants—and Chief Miller—first.

nodes.text: The rescued officer promised to hand-deliver it to your daughter this morning—along with the official letter clearing your name.
The mayor’s office already approved a sunlit memorial garden on this lot—with all thirteen names honored in bronze.
For the first time in six years, the crimson emergency lights inside Tower 13 blink off—replaced by natural golden daylight.
All seven rules are finished, Morgan. Come on—walk out through the front glass with me.

nodes.headline: All Seven Rules Complete
nodes.teaser_text: Next: At 06:00 AM sharp, Tower 13 comes down cleanly—and justice seals Victor Kade’s fate.

nodes.text: 06:00 AM · With every officer clear of the fence and Kade’s arson evidence safely archived, the city demolition crew clears the site.
News crews are broadcasting live from the perimeter: Victor Kade and Ray Mercer were just indicted on twelve counts of first-degree arson murder!
No more secret vaults, no more forged guard logs—and nobody will ever have to work a 3:00 AM shift in that building again.

nodes.transcript: [distant applause from crowd] "The fire chief just went on camera and read the truth aloud: the night guard of Tower 13 died a hero trying to save Floor 13."

nodes.text: Bail denied. All $18 million in insurance assets frozen by the court.

nodes.prompt: Sunlight floods the empty lobby desk one last time before the structure is dismantled:

options.label: Sign out of the logbook at 06:02 AM
options.player_reply_text: Logbook entry closed: Shift complete, perimeter secure, zero casualties.

options.label: Salute Chief Miller at the sunlit doorway
options.player_reply_text: It was an honor working the night shift with you, Chief.

nodes.text: Neatest logbook entry you ever wrote, Morgan. Even the ash is finally gone from the page.
Right back at you, guard. Twelve families finally have justice—and you finally have your name back.
The last intercom speaker in the lobby clicks off gently—leaving only the sound of morning birds outside.
Unit 911 archiving Tower 13 channel. Stand by for one final sign-off from the rescued officer.

nodes.headline: Name Cleared at Dawn
nodes.teaser_text: Next: The rescued officer makes one final call to honor the guard of Tower 13.

nodes.text: 06:12 AM · Across the street, the rescued officer stands beside the patrol van holding your polished brass badge as the sun climbs higher.
The officer asked to patch directly onto the Tower 13 line one last time before the carrier retires the number.
Tell him he did great down in B2—and remind him never to take an elevator in a fire.

nodes.transcript: [warm, steady young voice] "Thank you for lighting those exit arrows, sir. I’m driving your badge straight to your daughter right now. Rest easy."

nodes.text: Our families will never forget November 25—for all the right reasons now.

nodes.prompt: The radio battery indicator fades softly toward a warm golden glow:

options.label: Reply: "Watch over the city for me"
options.player_reply_text: Watch over the night shifts for me, kid. Tower 13 is signing off.

options.label: Reply: "Tell my daughter I’m proud of her"
options.player_reply_text: Tell my daughter I never stopped watching over her. Signing off.
